background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group A+, Moody's A1 and S&P A-, all stable, with no action since Fitch's upgrade to A+ on 4 Nov 2022. Capital is strong on a risk-weighted basis, CET1 of 14.9% in the top quarter of US banks, but leverage of 4.9% is in the bottom quarter and has fallen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025 on figures to 30 Jun 2026, which is the one measure to keep an eye on. Liquidity is comfortable, with LCR of 129% in the top quarter and broadly flat over the same period. Nothing of substance has been flagged in the last 90 days: the newest item, on 22 Sep 2026, is research the bank published on another company, and the only other is a ruling in a discovery dispute.
